test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**are**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the deltaic regions of India.
 
• In the fourth filler, we have to use the **auxiliary verb** '**are**'.
 
• According to the** subject-verb agreement rule**, a **verb** should be used according to **the main subject of the sentence.**
 
• Here, **'major deltas'** is the **main** subject which is **plural**. 
 
• Hence,** a plural helping verb **should be used. As the whole passage is in the **simple present tense**. So, we cannot use any other **tense** here.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

Correct Passage:__* The predominantly deltaic eastern coastal plain is an area of deep sedimentation. Over __most__ (1) of its length it is considerably wider __than__ (2) the plain on the western coast. __The__** (3) **major deltas, from south to north, __**are**__ **(4)** of the Kaveri, the Krishna-Godavari, the Mahanadi, and the Ganges-Brahmaputra rivers. The last of (5)________ is some 190 miles (300 km) wide, but only about one-third of it lies within India.*
